title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - Itinerary
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/Itinerary. Set of road segments that make up the route taken by a waste collection vehicle, from its depot to the collection points on its round and finally to a waste processing site. Subclass of geo:Feature and saref:FeatureOfInterest (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.2.1.3).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Itinerary'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geolocation of the itinerary, expressed as a GeoJSON LineString.

consistsOf.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/core/consistsOf'. An itinerary consists of one or more road segments (ontology restriction: allValuesFrom RoadSegment). Links to RoadSegment entities.

averageSpeedLimit.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/AverageSpeedLimit'. Mean speed limit for a road segment or an itinerary. Unit: km/h; not fixed by the ontology.

length.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/Length'. Length in distance of a journey or an itinerary. Unit: kilometre (km); not fixed by the ontology.
